findings.message: The abrirComanda definition updates contextoAtendimento, but its command output only returns comanda; no backend context replacement is available, so contextoAtendimento remains unchanged and this stale-state gap is reported.
The lancarItem command input had no declared input state. Added the minimum public lancarItemDraft state, LancarItemDraft type, and setLancarItemDraft setter.
The comandaId selection had no declared selection function. Added selectComanda(value) to publish or clear the selection and load the selected record.
